acceptanceCriteria: A refresh procedure or drift check compares observed per-shard step times with the committed prediction and flags drift above a stated bound.
Evidence from at least one run retained.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the CI-speed lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1105, head c464ca833, AFP-V0-060; costs from merge_group run 39120414701). Expected: package-costs.json/test-slices.json are refreshed periodically or a drift alarm fires when an observed shard exceeds the prediction by a bound. Actual: stale inputs drifted until shard 2 took 1542 s vs a 13.3 min ideal.
title: CI cost and slice tables have no staleness trigger, so shard balance silently drifts (shard 2 reached 1542 s)
